en: The postcard displays a black-and-white photograph of a formal, landscaped garden with geometric flower beds, staircases, ornamental lampposts, and a classical-looking music pavilion or bandstand. There are some people walking and sitting in the park. The top of the postcard reads 'Bad Pyrmont' and 'Kurhausterrasse'. The reverse side features a German postage stamp marked 'Deutsches Reich', handwritten text, a large blue museum stamp with 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont', and printed details.
